headline: Crypto Market Structure Brief - 22 October 2026
summary: Ethereum leads TVL at $49.9 billion, followed by Base at $6.2 billion and Solana at $5.9 billion. Uniswap V3 and V4 dominate DEX volumes with over $1.1 billion and $1.05 billion in 24-hour trading respectively. USDT holds $182.7 billion in circulation while several stablecoins show peg deviations. Multiple security incidents occurred in the prior fortnight, including a key compromise at Swell.
